items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: I don't even know in relation to Mary.

ctx.x: Well where is Lincoln Beach then?

I don't even know in relation to Mary. It's like you're going, you go past Mama Lewis and keep straight on the next stop is to Lincoln Beach. And then when you go straight on now, Mary's Camp, when you make that right turn to come. And Mary's Camp is farther down in Lincoln Beach.
Yeah, that's right. I thought maybe that's the same as Lincoln Beach now where you played before.
